mapper.select: select (IFNULL(psp.AMOUNT, 0) - IFNULL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0)) * 100 avaPledgePrin from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID, SUM(IFNULL(AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND HODING_TYPE = '04' AND SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID) pledge ON pledge.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and psp.finprod_id= #{finprodId} and psp.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId} and psp.cdate= (select max(cdate) from PTL_SEC_POSITION tt where tt.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} and tt.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and tt.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId})
mapper.update: UPDATE PTL_RECE_POSITION SET AMOUNT = AMOUNT + #{amount} where CDATE between str_to_date(#{minDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND str_to_date(#{maxDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UPDATE ETR_SEC_POSITION SET AMOUNT = AMOUNT + #{amount} where CDATE between str_to_date(#{minDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND str_to_date(#{maxDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
